<!-- pr-reviewer: 80df801458261e776f15660a65539db84c74e77d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blockers.

- The project fixture changes only its version, from 70 to 71. All other project values are identical.
- The new test checks the saved version against `PROJECT_VERSION`.
- The decision record explains the change and the accepted overlap with #2563.
- No UI, dependency, script, or process file changes.

Local results against upstream main `136f19763e791b397eb7b2609247230ac1007363`:

- The trial merge is clean. Main is already an ancestor of this head.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. It selects the full `continuous_4axis_part` suite.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test continuous_4axis_part`: 10 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed. The review worktree has no tracked changes.

Mutation check: restore the fixture from upstream main, then run each regression test separately.

- `the_committed_project_uses_the_current_file_version` fails with `left: Number(70)`, `right: 71`.
- `the_continuous_4axis_part_posts_its_wrapped_program` fails with `/version: 71 != 70`.
- Restore the PR fixture: both tests pass in the full suite.

The PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, simulation, gouge check, or collision check. This is not a safety-tier change.
The NC file is byte-identical to upstream main. Its SHA-256 is `5e27be6ad4976b2df42031025c53592571ec7e42729d7c5f3b3132ac6b2678b6`.
No NC or CL golden moves. I checked the single changed project line.

Requested before merge: none.

No GUI, hardware, full workspace, batch, or release tests ran. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 80df801458261e776f15660a65539db84c74e77d -->
Second review at head 80df80145, by the local review session. It confirms mkinney's marker.

Built result, in a worktree at the head, base `origin/main`:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test continuous_4axis_part`: 10 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The PR merges cleanly with `main`: `MERGEABLE`, and `main` is an ancestor of the head.

The checks:
- The diff touches three files. The project fixture changes one line: `version` from 70 to 71. No `.nc` or `.cl` golden moves.
- `PROJECT_VERSION` is 71 in `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`. The new test reads that constant, so it holds at the next format change without an edit.
- The decision entry names the overlap with #2563 and records the maintainer's acceptance on #2651. #2563 has the `conflicts` label; whichever of the two merges second takes a refresh of the same line.
- The body is complete: what changed, the readings, the pinning tests, what was not exercised, `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #2651`.

No blockers. Not a safety-tier change: no posted G-code, geometry, simulation or collision work moves.

Merge class: SAME. The head `80df801458261e776f15660a65539db84c74e77d` is the reviewed head, and no commit came after the reviews. The PR merges cleanly with `main` without a refresh.

This merge relies on the review by the local review session of this head (2026-11-19 01:22 UTC), which confirms the marker of mkinney. The PR is not under the safety floor: no posted program and no golden changes.
